Embedded terminal for 
MFP XEROX 
Scheme of a network configuration 
The « eTerminal-Xerox » embedded terminal works with the XEROX Multifunction and enables the 
communication between the MFP and the GESPAGE server. 
 
This embedded software enables secured printing thanks to user’s identification by entering a code on the 
touchscreen or by using a card. 
 
The eTerminal-Xerox makes using the MFP easier, more ergonomic and above all more productive in use. A 
simple click enables the user to interact with documents that he wishes to copy and print and this in 
compliance with confidentiality and GDPR regulations.
